source_brief: Agentic RFP Evaluation Mini Project, 6 pages

criteria.name: Manufacturing capability & process control
criteria.description: Facility fit, process understanding, equipment, batch controls, contamination prevention, validation approach.

criteria.name: GMP, quality system & product quality
criteria.description: GMP evidence, quality management system, deviations/CAPA, change control, batch records, OOS handling, traceability.

criteria.name: Regulatory readiness & documentation
criteria.description: Applicable manufacturing licences, inspection history, regulatory status, DMF/technical dossier support where applicable, document completeness.

criteria.name: Supply capacity & business continuity
criteria.description: Annual/monthly capacity, lead times, raw-material sourcing, inventory strategy, resilience, contingency plans.

criteria.name: Implementation & technology transfer
criteria.description: Project plan, milestones, validation/qualification, technology transfer, staffing, risks, realistic schedule.

criteria.name: Commercial value & price transparency
criteria.description: Unit price, MOQ, tooling/testing/packaging costs, payment terms, assumptions, total cost of ownership.

criteria.name: EHS, security & risk controls
criteria.description: Worker/environmental safety, waste handling, access control, data integrity, risk register and mitigation.

criteria.name: Support, experience & references
criteria.description: Relevant manufacturing history, complaint handling, recall support, technical service, references and response SLAs.
